text: Unlock the power of AI by connecting Smartsheet with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI clients through the Smartsheet MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. Using AI, you can read, analyze, and manage Smartsheet data, to compliment how you make decisions and get work done.Required plan: Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work ManagementMCP Connectors for ChatGPT, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Gemini Enterprise Plus, and Amazon Quick: Work with your Smartsheet projects in ChatGPT, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Gemini Enterprise Plus, and Amazon Quick.Create report tool: The create_report tool creates a new Smartsheet report that aggregates data from one or more source sheets or from all of the sheets in one or more workspaces.Unified sheet creation tool: You can now create sheets in a folder or workspace root, from a template or from scratch, using the create_sheet tool.Unified URL attachment tool: Attach URLs to a sheet, row, or comment, using the attach_url tool.Find text in a sheet: Search for text within a specific Smartsheet sheet, and get matching cells with row and column IDs, display values, and character offsets for each match. For details, go to the find_in_sheet tool documentation.List an assets shares: Use the new list_shares tool to list the groups and users shared to an asset.Work with favorites: Query and manage your listing of favorite assets. To learn more go to Favorites.Ready to dive in? Start hereOur Quickstart walks you through connecting the Smartsheet MCP server as an interactive companion in Claude Code. (These connection principles work across MCP-compatible AI clients.)The Smartsheet MCP server bridges the gap between Smartsheet and AI models, allowing you to:Access Smartsheet data in real timeApply AI reasoning with Smartsheet's project and data management featuresIntegrate with popular AI platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Gemini Enterprise Plus, custom AI clients, and moreAutomate complex tasks that require both data analysis and decision-makingInstead of manually copying data or writing custom API integrations, you can use AI clients to query Smartsheet, transform data, and trigger actions.The MCP server exposes Smartsheet capabilities as tools that AI models can invoke. When you integrate Smartsheet with an AI client:The AI client can access (with your consent) predefined tools to summarize sheets, create rows, update data, and more.The client determines which tools are needed to solve your requestsThe MCP server executes the request and returns structured dataThe AI client processes the results and provides a responseThis enables natural interactions like: "Show me all overdue tasks from the Marketing sheet and create a summary report" or "Update all project statuses based on the latest timeline changes."Dive into the following articles to connect your AI clients to the MCP server and familiarize yourself with the server's tools.Quickstart walks you through connecting the Smartsheet MCP server as an interactive companion in Claude Code. Query sheet structure, examine data patterns, and gather the information you need to write effective API code for sheet updates and more. (These connection principles work across MCP-compatible AI clients.)Install the Smartsheet MCP server has step-by-step instructions for connecting to the Smartsheet MCP server on your development environment.Smartsheet MCP server tools introduces some of the most popular tools and demonstrates how to get the latest details and sample prompts for all of the tools.After connecting to the MCP server and familiarizing yourself with available tools, you can:Create AI-powered automation workflowsIntegrate Smartsheet into broader AI agent systemsBuild custom Claude Skills that leverage Smartsheet dataDevelop bots that manage sheets and data autonomouslyAs you explore these possibilities, AI and the Smartsheet MCP server open the door to a new era of intelligent work management--where AI doesn't just assist, but actively helps you build, organize, and act on the data that drives your projects forward.
